questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of strict types?

options.text: declare it in typed application source
strict_types limits scalar coercion for calls from the declaring file
it does not validate HTTP input automatically
PHP automatically repairs the issue

questions.explanation: declare it in typed application source. Confirm with linting, focused tests, and observable failure handling.
